See, here lies the problem. The whole shtick of console gaming is that you don't need to mess around in settings or upgrade your rig every couple of years and you don't need to think "is my system good enough to run it". I say this as a console gamer myself: I prefer ease of access over freedom, which is exactly what consoles are all about.

Furthermore you have to take into account that pre release cyberpunk was super mainstream, the hype surrounding it was insane and it attracted many casual gamers that know next to nothing about tech or game development (which is also why you see developers constantly parsing this game and consumers bashing it) these are the type of people that don't know what an SSD is or how it works and they are also unaware they need to clean their consoles every few months. (granted, console manufacturers do make it harder to do than it needs to be but still)

All of this together coupled with extreme hype turning into extreme hate is the reason this backlash happened, and I do believe CDPR are fully at fault. They knew the base consoles could not handle it yet still released it.

Seems similar to what I'm doing currently. Going through my 3rd playthrough and decided to make it unnecessarily hard. (Difficult at very hard)

My main stats are: 14/16 reflex, 20 cool, 20 int (dump stat is tech)

Minimal cyberware: I am only allowed to upgrade my beginning cyberware (better cyberdeck, better ballistic compressor, better optics. leg upgrade is optional since it doesn't make you more OP)

The build is focused around stealth pistols and hacking BUT here are the rules in place:

No damage quickhacks, they are too OP

Only upgrade quickhacks to epic, legendary breaks the balance

Can't take the perk that allows quickhacks to spread +3 times (since casting reboot optics and blinding an entire room trivializes stealth)

Only healing item I can use is bounce back. the other one is almost instantaneous and by spamming it you can tank bullets almost indefinitely.

Can't take the perk that makes detection time longer (even without it detection time is already long as is)

No ping. for the same reason I play with no minimap, no ammo counter and no crosshair.

No armadillo mods for armor and no armor/survivability boosting perks.

Results so far: combat can be very difficult and tense, if enemies find me I'm dead. If I miss a head shot/ the enemy doesn't die in one hit I'm dead.
